verdict.rationale: Shopify POS documents multi-location operations: a centralized back office for 1,000+ locations, per-location inventory tracking that syncs in real time, and carts shared across devices and locations. Reporting and analytics are mentioned only generically, and there is no evidence of per-location device assignment or per-location settings. missing for 10: per-location device management, per-location settings configuration, location-segmented reporting, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can run multiple locations with per-location devices, settings, and reporting

citations.quote: Scale your business with a centralized back office that supports 1,000+ locations.
Track and assign inventory at every location that syncs in real time across POS, online store, and every sales channel.
Create and save carts in POS that can be retrieved, edited, and completed from other POS devices, retail locations, or sales channels.
